messages:
Anya: Quick follow-up from today's metering postmortem — thanks all. Summarizing owners/timeline for the billing incident (token undercount -> delayed invoices). Will use this thread for updates.
Samir: I'll own the token-ingest backfill. Plan: run backfill script against ingestion window 2025-06-01..2025-06-07, dry-run today, full run Wed. ETA: 3 business days. I'll post results + checksum.
Maria: I'll own invoice corrections. Need CSV of customer_id, invoice_id, delta_tokens, delta_amount. Samir can you drop that here after dry-run? Also need legal signoff for retro credits.
Owen: I'll set up recurrence detection and an alert for delayed batches. Hypothesis: monthly nightly batch retries causing token coalescence. Will add a regression rule to the metering pipeline. ETA end of week.
Jordan: FinanceBot created FIN-4287 (invoice corrections) and FIN-4288 (token backfill). Added watchers: @Maria @Samir @Owen
Samir: Dry-run logs: 4 customers, sample SQL used to validate token counts: ```SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM token_events WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2025-06-07' GROUP BY customer_id;``` Checksums matched except customer 4321 where metadata mismatch. Investigating.
Maria: For customer 4321, we need to confirm if tokens were double-counted on their side. I'll contact account owner @Lina and prep invoice reissue draft.
Owen: Added alert to Metrics: metering.delay.avg > 15m for >5% of requests -> pager to eng-oncall + eng-infra. Also scheduled a daily job to export late-window stats to S3 for audit.
Anya: Action items recap (copying into tickets):
  1) Backfill tokens (owner Samir) - due 2025-07-03 - acceptance: ledger delta reconciles to postmortem samples.
  2) Invoice corrections (owner Maria) - due 2025-07-07 - acceptance: corrected invoices sent + customer comms drafted.
  3) Recurrence detection + alerting (owner Owen) - due 2025-06-27 - acceptance: alert fires on synthetic delayed batch.
  4) Runbook + postmortem doc update (owner Anya) - due 2025-07-10 - acceptance: runbook published + ops playbook reviewed by eng-sre.
Jordan: Note: recurring pattern list to monitor: end-of-month spikes, cross-regional delayed ingest, 3rd-party connector retries. I'll add to FIN-4289 'recurrence patterns' and assign to eng-platform.
FinanceBot: Reminder: weekly check-in scheduled Thu 11:00am PT. Calendar invite created.
Samir: I'll post update after the dry-run completes. tagging @Maria for the CSV.
Maria: Ack. I'll wait for CSV and legal signoff. Thanks.
Anya: Thanks team :thumbsup: Keep updates to this thread.
